title: Idle Shooter Games for Android Explained: How They Work
subtitle: Auto-fire, big numbers and a loop you can play in short bursts.
description: Idle shooter games for Android explained: how auto-firing, upgrades, bosses, offline earnings and prestige fit together, with Capy Kingdom: Idle Shooter as an example.
card: What an idle shooter is, why the loop works on a phone, and what to look for in one, with Capy Kingdom: Idle Shooter as the worked example.

faq.q: What is an idle shooter game?
faq.a: An idle shooter is a game where your character fires automatically while you spend currency on upgrades. Numbers grow quickly, progress continues even when the app is closed, and you play in short sessions instead of reacting to every enemy.

faq.q: Do idle shooters need an internet connection?
faq.a: It depends on the game. Capy Kingdom saves progress on your device with no account, so the core game does not depend on a login. Rewarded ads and the support chat naturally need a connection.

faq.q: What is prestige in an idle game?
faq.a: Prestige is a reset you choose. You give up your current run and get a permanent bonus in return, so the next climb is faster. In Capy Kingdom this is called rebirth, and it pays Golden Yuzu.
